run_lsun_create_lmdb: run the lsun module to create an lmdb database from comma-separated input image files

run_lsun_output_path: run the lsun script with input_files and output_file flags to generate an lmdb store
review_lsun_main: review the lsun main function that reads image files and writes them into an lmdb database
